summary: Well-executed preregistered paired experiment comparing a generate–verify–repair (GVR) pipeline to LLM-only generation on a synthetic NetOps intent workload (N=500 pairs). Artifacts, hashes, and analysis are archived and largely consistent. The observed numerical improvement for GVR (0.8 percentage points; bootstrap 95% CI [0.002,0.016]; exact McNemar two-sided p=0.125) is transparently reported and correctly described as not meeting the preregistered significance threshold. The manuscript includes reasonable limitations and reproducibility pointers but currently overuses provenance metadata in narrative sections and omits a concise, human-readable verifier-specification summary.
critical_issues: The manuscript lacks a concise, explicit specification of the deterministic verifier’s rule set and a mapping of its violation codes to human-readable checks; readers cannot assess verifier coverage from the prose alone despite archived validator artifacts.

The preregistration specified two confirmatory tests (GVR vs LLM-only and GVR vs templated on complex intents) with a Bonferroni multiplicity plan, but the templated-automation comparator was not executed. The manuscript must explicitly state how this unexecuted confirmatory arm affects multiplicity interpretation and the handling of the predefined per‑test α in conclusions.

The paper’s prose currently substitutes artifact-inventory and provenance listings for normal literature-grounded exposition in multiple sections, making the manuscript read partially like an artifact report rather than a conference paper; this must be revised into concise scholarly narrative with provenance pointers consolidated in a reproducibility paragraph.
required_revisions: Add a short (one-paragraph or one-table) verifier specification extracted from deterministic_netops_validator_v5 artifacts: list rule categories checked (syntactic parsing, required-sequence/workflow-policy checks, protected-interface rules, group constraints, dependency rules, final-state comparison), enumerate violation codes with plain-English descriptions, and state known verifier blind spots. Point to the specific archived validator artifact path and hash for full detail.

Explicitly and unambiguously report the preregistration deviation: state that the templated-automation comparator was preregistered but not executed, and describe the consequence for multiplicity correction (i.e., that the originally pre-specified Bonferroni familywise plan could not be fully applied and how readers should interpret the reported p-value and CI). Update Abstract, Results, and Conclusion to include one clear sentence about this.

Refactor the manuscript prose to prioritize conventional scholarly exposition (motivation, prior work, methods, results, interpretation, limitations) and move extensive provenance/manifest listings into a single concise reproducibility paragraph or a compact appendix-style block (still within pages 1–5). Reduce in-text artifact inventory and ensure claims are supported by narrative interpretation rather than by raw artifact paths alone.
optional_revisions: Add a brief, explicit reconciliation paragraph or footnote explaining why the bootstrap CI excludes zero while the exact McNemar two-sided p-value is > preregistered α (authors already explain this; a one-sentence numerical intuition or small table would help readers).
Report the unadjusted significance decision (if any) alongside the preregistered adjusted-threshold decision to aid interpretation given the missing confirmatory arm.

Include a compact representative example (one task) with short natural-language walkthrough showing how verifier failure triggered a repair and how the repaired candidate passed, with pointers to the exact response and repair traces in the artifact bundle.
